summary: All 4 ERA5-detected AR events for Aug-Oct 2026 cross-check against independent official/agency sources. 395349fe (Aug 19-21): confirmed - ongoing monsoon-trough flooding in Myanmar/Lao PDR (AHA Centre flash updates of 19 Aug) and IMD monsoon-low press releases; peak IVT 1298 kg/m/s is plausible for the BoB/SCS monsoon flow but near a late-window tropical cyclone (NARRA, 23-26 Aug), so minor TC-circulation contamination cannot be excluded (below the 2000 flag threshold). 9700e4af (Sep 28-Oct 1): confirmed by NOAA WPC storm summary 'September 29-October 02, 2026 - Southwest to Central U.S. Heavy Rainfall' (7 issued summaries) and NWS/WFO summaries - but the moisture plume was tropical-origin (remnants of ex-Cat-5 Hurricane Polo + frontal boundary) affecting the Southwest/Central US rather than a classic BC/West-coast landfall; peak IVT 1785 kg/m/s is high but sub-threshold, with possible contamination from Polo's remnants over Mexico (bbox includes Polo track). 029719d1 (Sep 29-Oct 3): confirmed by BOM severe weather warnings and Australian media (ABC, Guardian, Weatherzone): 48-90 mm daily totals, flood watch over most of Victoria Oct 1-3; IVT 715 plausible; note event followed record-dry September (Copernicus/ABC). 66b5b9f6 (Oct 14-17): confirmed - Baltic gale/storm-surge sequence building Oct 15-16 (Estonian SMHI/Meteoalarm, SMHI yellow warnings for Skane, BSH Vorabinformation 16 Oct) peaking as the first autumn 'mittlere Sturmflut' on the German Baltic coast Oct 17-18 (end of window); Copernicus October bulletin confirms wet anomaly over N Germany/southern Scandinavia; IVT 815 plausible. No peak IVT exceeds the 2000 kg/m/s TC-contamination flag threshold; 9700e4af is flagged as near-threshold with documented tropical-remnant influence in-bbox.
